newsitem.title: USA: Smith's Food lock-up restrictions expire.
newsitem.headline: Smith's Food lock-up restrictions expire.

text.p: Smith's Food & Drug Centers Inc said lock-up restrictions on the sale of about five million shares of its Class A common stock have expired.
It said the lock-up was part of its recapitalization and merger with Smitty's Supermarkets which closed in May 1996.

In response to an inquiry, the company advised the New York Stock Exchange of the lapse of such lock-up restrictions and stated that it was not aware of any other extraordinary developments which would account for the trading activity in its stock today. The stock closed down 2-3/4 at 27-3/4.
